title: Initial velocity v0
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial horizontal velocity v0 = 4 m/s using projectile motion from A to B.

title: Speed at point B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at point B = 5 m/s using vector addition of horizontal and vertical components.

title: Pressure at point C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force/pressure on the track at C = 47.3 N using centripetal force and energy conservation.

title: Minimum plank length
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum plank length = 2.0 m using relative motion and friction analysis.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: Applies kinematics to find the time of flight and vertical velocity at B from the vertical displacement H-h.

title: Energy conservation to C
description: Important: Uses work-energy theorem or conservation of energy to find the speed of the block at point C.

title: Friction force analysis
description: Important: Correctly identifies that the block-plank friction (7 N) is less than the maximum ground-plank friction (10 N), so the plank remains stationary.

title: Centripetal force at C
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law at point C with correct centripetal acceleration direction.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for gravitational force in the centripetal force equation at point C.

title: Friction misconception
description: Pitfall: Assumes the plank moves, incorrectly applying relative motion or two-body dynamics.
